edges.reason: msg.sender (via _msgSender) drives the from/owner role checks and exclusions in _transfer, letting the owner bypass fees and limits.
msg.sender is passed to _mint in the constructor and receives the whole supply.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against _owner before trading can be enabled.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against _owner before setBalance can move pair tokens.
onlyOwner gate lets the owner remove all transfer limits.
onlyOwner gate lets the owner disable transfer delay.
onlyOwner gate lets the owner change the swap threshold.
onlyOwner gate lets the owner whitelist arbitrary addresses from max transaction limits.
onlyOwner gate lets the owner raise buy fees up to 20 percent.
onlyOwner gate lets the owner raise sell fees up to 25 percent.
onlyOwner gate lets the owner relax the effective sell fee cap via _feeLimiter.
onlyOwner gate lets the owner redirect the marketing wallet to any address.
onlyOwner gate lets the owner redirect the dev wallet to any address.
onlyOwner gate lets the owner blacklist arbitrary addresses, blocking transfers.
block.timestamp is used as the router swap deadline, making execution miner-influenceable.
The router swap consumes block.timestamp as its deadline parameter.
from parameter feeds the zero-address, bot and AMM branch checks.
to parameter feeds the zero-address, dead-address and AMM branch checks.
amount feeds fee multiplication/division and the final unchecked subtraction.
botBlocks is stored into _botBlocks without bound checks from the caller.
amount controls how many liquidity-pair tokens the owner pulls out.
newNum lowers the max transaction amount enforced on all users.
account is written into _isExcludedFromFees, permanently exempting it from fees.
contractTokenBalance is read from balanceOf(address(this)) inside _transfer.
contractTokenBalance compared against swapTokensAtAmount triggers swapBack.
fees local is computed from amount and the total fee percentages.
fees computed with mul/div are then subtracted from amount before the final transfer.
maxFees local derived from the fixed 10 percent limit.
maxFees.sub(_feeLimiter) can revert on underflow if _feeLimiter exceeds 10.
tokensForLiquidity accumulator incremented with fee-share arithmetic.
tokensForMarketing accumulator incremented with fee-share arithmetic.
tokensForDev accumulator incremented with fee-share arithmetic.
tradingActive must be true or the sender must be fee-excluded, gating early transfers.
limitsInEffect gates the max transaction checks applied to buys and sells.
swapping flag is set true before swapBack and cleared afterwards, acting as the reentrancy guard.
contractBalance is read from balanceOf(address(this)) in swapBack.
contractBalance is split by the liquidity share to size liquidityTokens.
liquidityTokens is subtracted from contractBalance to get amountToSwapForETH.
amountToSwapForETH is passed into swapTokensForEth.
The entire contract ETH balance is forwarded to marketingWallet through a low-level call.
swapTokensForEth forwards tokenAmount and the path into the router swap call.
setBalance uses the internal _transfer to move liquidity-pair tokens to the owner.
totalSupply local is computed as 1e12 * 1e18 and minted.
Constructor stores the Uniswap V2 router address in state.
Constructor creates and stores the Uniswap V2 pair address.
Constructor marks the created pair as an automated market maker pair.
Constructor calls _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair to register the pair.
Constructor calls excludeFromFees for owner, contract, dev and marketing wallets.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the private _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the automatedMarketMakerPairs mapping.
excludeFromFees writes the _isExcludedFromFees mapping.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes the _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount mapping.
enableTrading calls openTrading to record the first block and set tradingActive.
Enabling trading unlocks the fee and limit branches inside _transfer.
_transfer invokes swapBack before performing the final token transfer.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert accumulated tokens.
renounceOwnership clears _owner, permanently removing owner-only privileges.
setBalance is only callable while _owner still matches msg.sender.
The low-level ETH call to marketingWallet can re-enter swapBack or _transfer while swapping is still true.
The router swap interacts with the token contract and can re-enter _transfer before state settles.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to feed checks and balance updates inside _transfer.
The to parameter only exists to feed checks, fee branches and balance updates inside _transfer.
amount is the operand of the fee multiplication and the unchecked amount reduction.
botBlocks is only consumed to initialize _botBlocks in openTrading.
amount only parameterizes the pair-balance withdrawal in setBalance.
newNum is only used to overwrite maxTransactionAmount.
account is only used to write the fee-exclusion mapping.
contractTokenBalance only decides whether swapBack is invoked from _transfer.
fees is a temporary holding the result of the fee arithmetic.
maxFees is a temporary used in the fee-limit subtraction.
contractBalance is a scratch value inside swapBack.
liquidityTokens is a scratch value inside swapBack.
amountToSwapForETH is the sole argument passed into swapTokensForEth.
totalSupply only exists as the mint amount computed in the constructor.
